findings.detail: Filesystem walk has no timeout; large repos directories could take very long
findings.recommendation: Add context timeout or limit walk depth/duration

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Slow filesystem could block request thread for extended time

findings.detail: Has cleanup logic via defer that deletes failed DB records if adoption fails
findings.recommendation: Current implementation handles partial failure well

non_atomic_operations: DB record created first, then git operations; defer cleanup handles rollback
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Git operations failure triggers DB cleanup
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Deferred cleanup deletes partial DB state on failure

findings.detail: Global lock prevents concurrent execution of same task; safe to retry

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Task failure is isolated; creates notice but doesn't affect API response
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Task runs async; API returns 204 immediately regardless of task outcome

findings.detail: Token creation uses transaction to deactivate old tokens and create new one atomically

graceful_shutdown.detail: Graceful manager handles SIGTERM, drains in-flight requests, stops cron scheduler

rate_limiting.detail: No rate limiting on admin API endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Consider adding rate limiting for admin endpoints to prevent abuse

dead_letter_queues.detail: No async message flows in these endpoints
